Companion Animal Travel Desk Pet Travel Guidance

This article summarizes the main steps for traveling with an animal on Aurelia Skyways. It is intended to help travelers prepare documents, containers, and check-in arrangements before departure.

Begin by confirming that the animal is accepted for the planned route and that its carrier meets airline standards. The crate or carrier should allow the animal to stand, turn, and lie down comfortably, and it should remain secure throughout handling. Bring any health papers, entry permits, or care instructions that apply to the journey.

For reptile transport, use a suitable crate and follow the approved packing method. <<FACT F072>> Place absorbent lining inside the container and secure all closures before arrival at the airport. If the animal needs special feeding or temperature care, inform the desk as early as possible so staff can review the request calmly.

For bird travel, verify that the animal meets the boarding conditions before you travel. <<FACT F077>> Keep the carrier clean, ventilated, and firmly latched, and avoid adding loose items that could shift during transit. A quiet, darkened cover may be allowed when it does not interfere with ventilation or inspection.

For small dog travel, review the applicable fee before booking. <<FACT F056>> Prepare the carrier in advance and label it clearly with contact details. Travelers should also arrive early enough to allow staff to inspect the animal and the documents together.

Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and any concern is reviewed through a calm stepwise process. For further help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
